extracted.name: Rosemary, garlic & chilli popcorn
extracted.description: Spice up popcorn with rosemary, chilli and garlic for a quick and easy snack. It's healthy, vegan and gluten-free
ingredient_lines: 1 tsp chipotle or other chilli flakes
½ small bunch of rosemary finely chopped
instruction_lines: Heat the oil in a saucepan over a medium heat, then fry the garlic, chilli and rosemary for 2-3 mins. Remove from the heat, set aside and leave the oil to infuse for 30 mins.
Cook the popcorn according to pack instructions. Scoop the garlic out of the infused oil and discard. Toss the popcorn with the oil, then season and serve straightaway.
